in_hebrew.name: בַפְטִילְסָתָה
in_hebrew.meaning: God is my strength in baptism
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Baptlsta would be written as בַפְטִילְסָתָה (bəp̄ṭiləsātāh) in the Tiberian Hebrew system. The name is derived from the Hebrew roots בַפְטִיל (bəp̄ṭil), meaning 'to dip, immerse, or purify', and סָתָה (sātāh), meaning 'strength'. So, the name Baptlsta would mean 'God is my strength in baptism'.

in_greek.name: Βαπτιστία
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Baptlsta would be written as Βαπτιστία (Baptistia). This name is derived from the Greek word βάπτισμα (baptisma), which means 'baptism'. The name Baptlsta would mean 'one who is baptized' or 'baptist' in Greek.

in_latin.name: Baptista
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Baptlsta would be written as Baptista. This name is derived from the Latin word baptizatus, which means 'baptized'. The name Baptlsta would mean 'baptized one' in Latin.
